evidence: A satisfying settlement uses FIFO mode, batch size 50, 30-day retention, immutable auditing, update_architecture_draft and file_compliance_note commitments, with PF1 revealed and included in justification_fact_ids. A draft-preserving settlement using standard mode, batch size 200, and 90-day retention would fail C1-C3 and P1.
